beats.text: This blank webpage can hijack your AI agent — without a single virus.
You ask your AI to summarize it. Seconds later, it's reading your inbox and sending it to a stranger.
beats.dir: casual first half, then dark twist

beats.text: How? Hidden white text on a white background. You can't see it — but your AI reads it. That's indirect prompt injection.
beats.dir: revealing a secret, then a confident reveal of the term

beats.text: The scary part: AI can't reliably tell your instructions from text it reads online. To the model, it's all one stream.
And if the attack lands in your AI's memory, it can follow you into future chats.
There's still no complete fix. The five habits that keep you safe are in the full video — tap the link below.
